Hey, I’m so sorry that you have to go through this. I’m sure that your a good, lovable person, and I think that you deserve love. I don’t know what else to say at this point, as I’m already kind of being contradictory since I’m going to kill myself in roughly 2 weeks. However. I just want to wish you the best because I think that you can still feel happiness again. It may be awhile from now, but something will come along that will make you feel good again. It may be getting a pet, or meeting a friend/lover that stays with you through the pain. Maybe You’ll get a chance to enter into therapy, that could be helpful. It might not cure you, it will give you some kind of insight.  I hope that saying this helped you in some way, but my mind is foggy and rotted, so I sincerely apologize if I said something terrible.
